No LinkedIn session cookie found.

Log in to linkedin.com in your browser, open DevTools -> Application -> Cookies -> https://www.linkedin.com, and copy the value of `li_at`.
Then store it once with:

    linkedin-api-mcp auth

or set LINKEDIN_COOKIE in the environment for a throwaway session.
Full instructions: https://github.com/JohannsenLum/linkedin-api-mcp#getting-your-session-cookie
